ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) across approximately 95% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters limited to localized surface markings and distal tip encrustations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a continuous low-intensity dark field. High-contrast white geometric blobs are present as fine linear streaks and small circular focal points scattered across both lobes. Distinct, highly-textured high-intensity clusters are mapped to the extreme lateral tips (coordinates: top-left and top-right extremities).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 60 degrees; high pixel-depth penetration toward the fluke base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrated boundary. The trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (3-10 pixel depth) interspersed with occasional deeper notches (15-20 pixel depth), particularly on the medial-to-lateral transition zones of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve that transitions into a sharp upward sweep at the distal tips, creating a tapered, wing-like silhouette.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-contrast, irregular circular pixel groupings at the distal tips, indicating barnacle colonization. Smaller, isolated circular white spots are visible in the upper-left and central-right regions of the dark field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths (10-100 pixels) distributed across both lobes, with a high concentration of parallel streaks on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white-on-black linear scarring across the central ventral surface; significant biological encrustations causing textured protrusion at both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral edges exhibit a 'fringed' appearance due to high-density barnacle clusters, breaking the expected linear geometric contour of the fluke tips.
